checkTicket.heading: Check Your Ticket
checkTicket.intro: Enter your numbers and draw date to instantly see whether your Florida Lottery ticket matches the latest results.
howItWorks: Enter your numbers exactly as printed on your ticket.
For large wins, follow the Claim Info steps to submit your ticket safely.
checkTicket.note: Type your numbers carefully. If a mistake is made, simply re-enter them and run the check again.

items.q: What are today's Florida Lottery numbers?
items.a: The latest Florida Lottery winning numbers for all games appear in the Latest Draw Results section above, updated shortly after each drawing.

items.q: How do I check my Florida Lottery ticket?
items.a: Use the Check Your Ticket tool: pick the game and draw date, enter your numbers, and review the matches.

items.q: Where do I go to claim a Florida Lottery prize?
items.a: Smaller prizes can be claimed at authorized retailers; larger prizes are claimed at district offices or Lottery Headquarters. See How to Claim below.

items.q: Are Florida Lottery winnings taxed by the state?
items.a: Florida does not charge a state income tax on lottery winnings; federal tax rules still apply.

howToClaim.heading: How to Claim Florida Lottery Prizes
howToClaim.intro: Learn how to claim Florida Lottery prizes step-by-step, from small retailer payouts to large jackpot claims at district offices.

claimOptions.method: Claim at most authorized retailers or District Offices
Claim at a District Office or by mail
Claim in person at a District Office
Must be claimed in person at Lottery Headquarters

documents: Social Security number or SSN card
Additional forms for annuity or lifetime prizes

steps.title: Sign your winning ticket
steps.detail: Immediately sign the back of your ticket to protect ownership.

steps.title: Confirm the amount you won
steps.detail: Use the Check Ticket tool or the Latest Draw Results section.

steps.title: Choose the correct claim method
steps.detail: Based on prize amount, from retailer payout to Lottery Headquarters.

steps.title: Complete the required paperwork
steps.detail: Winner Claim Form, W-2G if applicable, direct deposit forms for large prizes.

steps.title: Submit your claim
steps.detail: In person or by mail (certified mail recommended).

deadlines: Draw games: 180 days from draw date
Scratch-Off games: 60 days after the game officially ends
Mailed claims: envelope must be postmarked by the deadline
howToClaim.districtOffices: Larger prizes can be claimed at district offices statewide, including Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Fort Myers, and Escambia. Appointments are recommended for jackpot and annuity prizes.

playerInfo.heading: Florida Lottery Guide & Player Information
playerInfo.intro: Key information Florida Lottery players should understand, including draw integrity, basic rules, responsible play guidance, and where lottery funds go.

sections.title: Draw Integrity & Oversight
sections.body: Lottery drawings in Florida follow strict procedures designed to ensure fairness and randomness. Draw machines are inspected before each drawing, numbered balls are tested and weighed, and results are transmitted only after verification.

sections.title: Key Florida Lottery Rules
list: Minimum age to play: 18
Tickets must be signed to become valid property
Damaged or unreadable tickets follow a formal review process
Retailers cannot refuse to check a ticket
Draw cutoff times vary by game

sections.title: Responsible Play (Florida Guidelines)
list: Set a weekly budget
Understand that odds are fixed
Avoid chasing losses
Florida's gambling helpline is available for support

sections.title: Where Lottery Money Goes
sections.body: A significant portion of Florida Lottery revenue supports state education programs, including scholarships and school enhancements. Each year, hundreds of millions of dollars are allocated to Florida's Education Enhancement Trust Fund.

items.q: What time are Florida Lottery drawings held?
items.a: Draw times vary by game; times on this page use Eastern Time (ET). See the Schedule section for each game's days and times.

items.q: Can I buy Florida Lottery tickets online?
items.a: Ticket-buying options vary. Use the Buy Tickets links where available; the final destination is provided by our partner service.

items.q: Can I stay anonymous if I win the Florida Lottery?
items.a: Anonymity rules vary by prize amount and state law. Confirm current rules with the official Florida Lottery before claiming.

items.q: Can a group of people claim a prize together?
items.a: Group wins are allowed with proper documentation. Each member typically completes the required forms.
Florida has no state income tax on winnings; federal withholding of 24% applies to prizes over $5,000.

items.q: What is the minimum age to play the Florida Lottery?
items.a: You must be 18 or older to play the Florida Lottery.

items.q: What happens to unclaimed lottery prizes in Florida?
items.a: Unclaimed prize funds are transferred to Florida's Education Enhancement Trust Fund.
